note: Brand atoms: these colours and the Inter / JetBrains Mono type are fixed. Each world is a full colour set; qa.py script checks every world's contrast. Accent is the 10% colour: the highlighted word and the progress bar. cost and gain are functional signal colours, used only on the wow number: cost (coral) for the problem, gain (teal) for the result. Coral vs teal stays distinguishable with colour blindness; never red vs green.
